description:
Parts of gf2 carry Lean 4 proofs over extracted code. Researchers integrating or extending them need the current pipeline steps.

## Background

Permanent pages target researchers evaluating or adopting gf2 and assume technical competence. Explanatory prose is freshly authored; only independently verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and empirical data are reused from prior material. Pages state current supported behavior only.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A page under `docs/how-to/` shows how to run the Lean 4 extraction and proof pipeline, build the proofs, and add a proof for an extracted function, verified against current code, manifests and tests.
- [hard] REQ-02: Its prose and structure are freshly authored; reused items from `docs/lean4-verification-pipeline.md`, `proofs/README.md` and `proofs/WORKAROUNDS.md` are limited to verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and data.
- [hard] REQ-03: It contains no elementary primer, historical narration, migration language, speculation, future promise, marketing language or performance figure.
- [hard] REQ-04: `proofs/README.md` keeps only directory orientation and links to the how-to for the workflow.
- [hard] REQ-05: The page is listed in `docs/index.md`, and its links, anchors and citations resolve.
title: Write the formal verification how-to
